description: This file initializes a React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the App component, then creates a root and renders the application within React.StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the DOM element.
